spanish: E hizo la menorá de oro puro; de martillo hizo la menorá; su muslo y su caña, sus cálices, sus manzanas y sus flores, desde ella fueron.

findings.issue: menorá leaves the common noun untranslated; H4501 stays a Spanish common noun
de supplies a material link on the appositional gold+pure phrase; smoothing, same meaning
martillo names the tool; H4749 is a feminine noun of beaten work, not a hammer
manzanas adds apples; H3730 licenses a knob or capital, not fruit
desde ella fueron reads as they went; the tokens license they were from it

notes: Muslo, singular caña, cálices as cups, flores, and both 3ms hizo clauses match the tokens.
